approved_scope_unchanged: selout v8 SOUTH IDLE static frame and the 48 logical px display scale only

display.body_draw_offset: none: the body (every part except the legs) is drawn at the logical position
display.stance_boot: drawn at the window row fixed on landing; its leg is re-stacked from v8 rows each tick

rig.leg_rule: rows hip(61+bob) .. boot top-1 = thigh + v8 knee band (whole) + shin, thigh/shin rows by nearest whole-row pick in proportion to v8's lengths; knee lean kin texels inward, thigh lean grows with t^2, shin returns to 0 at the boot; pinhole fill as v01

stop.rule: on the release tick the hero stops (runtime unchanged).  1) every boot in the air flies to its v8 spot and lands (lift falls monotonically); 2) then each planted boot that is not on its v8 spot does one short shuffle step (lift <= 4 rows) to it, rearmost first; a planted boot never moves while planted; at most one boot changes its view or touches down per tick (the other holds one tick); 3) arms return to N one arm per arm_step_ms, only on ticks where no boot changes; the bob keeps its release value (no dip when a flight release lands) and returns to 0 settle_ms after the last landing; hair / cape lag hair_lag_ms and move at most one row per tick; 4) the tick after the composite equals v8 (neutral state), the v8 PNG itself is shown.
stop.land_keys: [[0, o0, l0, view0, kin0], [600, rdiv(o0, 3), max(rdiv(l0, 3), min(4, rdiv(|o0|, 3))), reach, 0], [1000, 0, 0, strike, 0]]; at u >= 1000 the boot is v8's boot on its spot (contact)

restart.rule: on a re-press the planted boot (if two: the more forward one; tie: the one that landed LAST) stays in stance and keeps its window row; the gait phase is re-derived from its offset (phase = land_offset - o); the other boot (if planted: lifted now; if in the air: kept where it is) gets a re-planned swing from its current offset / lift to land_offset at its next scheduled landing (the stride sync of 48 px is kept).  The leg that landed last is never the one that lifts first, so the next touchdown is always the other boot.  With both boots in the air the frozen phase resumes.  Arms ease to the gait pose one arm and one pose step (B1 / N / F1) per tick until they match it.
restart.replan_keys: [[0, o0, l0, heelup if view0 == v8 else view0, kin0], [500, rdiv(o0 + land_offset, 2), max(l0, hs), hang, 1], [800, land_offset - 1, rdiv(hs, 2), reach, 0], [1000, land_offset, 0, strike, 0]]; hs = clamp(rdiv(8 * remaining_px, stride_px - stance_px), replan_lift_min, replan_lift_max)

size_cost.runtime_lookup: per tick: phase = travelled window px mod stride; feet from the stance rule / swing keys; stop and re-press by the rules above; no sub-pixel stop table
